liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Morning Dew** (4 reviews): Reviewer praises natural transitions from Dew into Playin', then Uncle John's Band and back into Playin'; Opening Dew is described as very mellow, leading into a relaxed, trippy set [8][10][15][18]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 other source): Timings given: Playing In The Band runs 14:55 and the reprise runs 6:52 [6]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): Named a highlight of the show [15]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): The soundboard captured Wharf Rat, which the reviewer cites as reason for five stars [14]

## The recordings

- **gd73-11-01.sbd.cribbs.22795.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 12 songs; 112 min [1]
- **gd1973-11-01.136696.set2.sbd.sirmick.flac16**: soundboard; 9 songs; 93 min; rated 5/5 by 4 [2]. Said about its sound: Described as super crispy; Called the cleanest recording yet, with almost no distortion on Phil's bass lines; Uploader calls this anonymous-source version clean, with DC offset removed and gain raised after level adjustments [2][16][18]
- **gd73-11-01.sbd.parrillo.8834.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 9 songs; 93 min; rated 4.31/5 by 13 [3]. Said about its sound: Complete second set of about 94 minutes, described as top-notch Dead; Reviewer says the sound quality of this second-set soundboard is good; Donna's vocals sound more prominent than on many other shows [8][9][10]
- **gd1973-11-01.sbd.set2.goodbear.80714.flac16**: soundboard; 9 songs; 92 min [5]
- **gd1973-11-01.sbd-set2.goodbear.2178.shnf**: soundboard; 9 songs; 92 min [6]

## Around the show

- The first set is missing from this tape; DeadBase lists it as including Promised Land, Sugaree, China Cat> I Know You Rider and Let It Grow [8]
- Attendee saw a wall of JBL speakers stacked high; says it was the only decent-sounding show in this hangar-like hall [10]
- Attendee says the sound system already used McIntosh amps, noise-canceling vocal mics and many JBL drivers, before the Wall of Sound's formal 1974 start [11]
- Reviewer's driver friend insisted on leaving at the break because there were no women present, so he missed the second set [12]
- Reviewer attended on their 19th birthday and doubts the administration's fuss, noting Mahavishnu Orchestra and Jethro Tull also played McGaw [13]
- Reviewer is surprised the band took an hour-long set break at this concert [14]
- Source includes a first set with Here Comes Sunshine, Weather Report Suite Prelude and Part 1, and Let It Grow [1]
- The full Wall of Sound arrived in March 1974 at the Cow Palace, San Francisco; this show had many of its elements [11]
- Reviewer says this version surpasses any other on the Archive [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-11-01.sbd.cribbs.22795.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Lineage is MSR > C > DAT > PCM > DAT > CD, then extracted, edited and encoded to SHN by Sean Cribbs in December 2003 [1]
- **gd1973-11-01.136696.set2.sbd.sirmick.flac16**: transferred by SIRMick; source: Set 2 Source: Soundboard > Master-Reel > Reel (1st gen) > DAT (44.1k) [2]. Also: Small gaps in Uncle John's Band and He's Gone, common to other circulating sources, were closed up [2]
- **gd73-11-01.sbd.parrillo.8834.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]
- **gd1973-11-01.sbd.set2.goodbear.80714.flac16**: transferred by Teddy Goodbear; source: Originally seeded in 11/2000 as: MR>C1>DAT>(shnid=2178)* [5]. Also: Chain is MR>C1>DAT, first seeded November 2000, then CD, EAC and CoolEdit hiss reduction, reseeded 3 December 2006; Teddy "Good Bear" Selby encoded the FLAC files; the original SHN release was posted to alt.binaries.gdead.highspeed [5]
- **gd1973-11-01.sbd-set2.goodbear.2178.shnf**: transferred by Teddy Goodbear; source: MR>C1>DAT [6]. Also: Teddy "Good Bear" encoded to SHN and first posted it to alt.binaries.gdead.highspeed in November 2000 [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead McGaw Memorial Hall](https://www.dead.net/venue/mcgaw-memorial-hall) [20]
- Fan art by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1973-11-01 Thu McGaw Hall, Northwestern University, Evanston, IL](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1423752281652/grateful-dead-1973-11-01-thu-mcgaw-hall) [21]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead McGaw Memorial Hall](https://www.dead.net/venue/mcgaw-memorial-hall) [22]
- Fan art by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1973-11-01 Thu McGaw Hall, Northwestern University, Evanston, IL](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1423752281652/grateful-dead-1973-11-01-thu-mcgaw-hall) [23]
- Fan art by deadsources.blogspot.com: [November 1, 1973: McGaw Hall, Northwestern University, Evanston IL](https://deadsources.blogspot.com/2023/12/november-1-1973-mcgaw-hall-northwestern.html) [24]
